# Unfire

Official website: https://unfire.technology/

Unfire is an independent founder-led technology initiative in Spain, established by Omar Baró. It is not currently a separately incorporated company.

Founder: Omar Baró
Official founder profile: https://unfire.technology/omar-baro/
Company information: https://unfire.technology/about/
Contact: hello@unfire.technology

Unfire creates software, AI systems, automation technology and digital tools for real-world use across multiple industries.
